items.item_text: 01. I understand that SBCEO has an in-person work culture, and this position is designated as fully in-person at the site listed on the position announcement and may require travel throughout the county. I also understand that any request for a remote work arrangement will be reviewed in accordance with applicable laws and SBCEO’s remote work policy and procedure. Remote work arrangements are granted at SBCEO’s sole discretion. Options: I acknowledge and understand the above.

02. SBCEO operates under the California Merit System, meaning that promotions are achieved only through competitive examination, not automatic progression or supervisory discretion. Do you acknowledge and understand that advancement occurs only through the Merit System competitive process? Options: I acknowledge and understand that advancement occurs only through the Merit System competitive process.

03. Initial placement will occur within the salary range $140,603 - $171,311 per year based on experience, education, and internal alignment. Do you acknowledge and understand the salary range and initial placement process? Options: I acknowledge and understand the salary range and initial placement process.

04. List any active professional IT certifications you hold that are relevant to this position (e.g., ITIL, Cisco, Microsoft, VMware, AWS, CompTIA). Please include an attachment of the certification, which includes the certification title, issuing organization, and expiration/status.

05. Describe your supervisory or leadership experience in an IT environment. Include the scope of your responsibilities and the types of staff or functions you led. Ensure the experience described is also reflected in the work experience section of your application. (300 word maximum)

06. Describe your progressively responsible experience in IT operations, infrastructure, or systems support. Include the scope and complexity of your responsibilities and the types of systems, infrastructure, or services you supported or managed. Ensure the experience described is also reflected in the work experience section of your application. (300 word maximum)

07. Describe your experience supporting or managing IT operations in a complex, multi-site environment that includes both cloud-based and on-premises systems. Include the scope of the environment and your specific responsibilities. Ensure the experience described is also reflected in the work experience section of your application. (300 word maximum)
IT operations in the public sector or K–12 educational environments.
Gather and analyze data, draw conclusions, and support decision-making.
IT service management frameworks (e.g., ITIL) and operational best practices.
Analyze complex technical and organizational challenges and implement scalable, future-ready solutions.
ERP systems supporting financial, HR, and administrative functions.
Learn and apply California education code, Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act, Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act, federal regulations, and California data privacy requirements.
Network infrastructure, cloud computing, virtualization, and hybrid IT environments.
Establish and adjust priorities, projects, and service demands in a dynamic environment.
Identity and access management (IAM), directory services (e.g., Active Directory, Azure AD), and role-based access control (RBAC).
Build consensus and foster collaboration among diverse stakeholder groups.
VoIP and unified communications systems, including telephony infrastructure, call management, and conferencing platforms.
Hire, develop, and lead high-performing technical teams.
Audio/visual systems, including classroom and conference room technologies, control systems, and media integration.
Prepare a wide variety of written documents and reports.
Cybersecurity standards such as NIST, CIS Controls, and Zero Trust architecture principles.
Represent the department effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
Endpoint management, device provisioning, and configuration management tools.
Oral and written communication.
Public speaking and presentation.
Balance operational stability with modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption and security enhancements.
Communicate effectively with technical staff, educators, administrators, and external partners.
